BiblicalUsage: Besai means "my treading." He was a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel. It turns up in Ezra 2:49 and Nehemiah 7:52.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Besai is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
